items.title: Synopsys Boosts Annual Outlook as AI Complexity Drives Demand
items.summary: On Wednesday, Synopsys, Inc. (NASDAQ:SNPS) reported strong third-quarter results and raised outlook. During the call, CEO Sassine Ghazi said AI is creating unprecedented complexity and driving stronger demand for the silicon IP and engineering solutions needed to build next-generation AI computing, infrastructure and physical AI systems.
